profile.summary: I have been developing web applications since 2019, specializing in Angular and TypeScript, with a focus on the framework’s latest features, including Signals and Standalone Components. I have worked both as a developer and as a team lead on fintech projects and cloud platforms, taking responsibility for architecture, development, code quality, and collaboration with clients and stakeholders. I integrate Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot, Claude Code, and OpenCode into my daily workflow, using custom skills and MCP servers to make code generation, refactoring, and documentation more precise and consistent with the project’s architecture.

orbyta.role: Senior IT Consultant - Frontend & Application Architecture
orbyta.description: Frontend consulting for modern and high-performance web applications. Development with advanced Angular, Signals, RxJS, NgRx, PrimeNG, Tailwind and Bootstrap; architecture definition with the client and autonomous management of priorities and delivery. Integration with Java backends and real-time features through STOMP. Use of Cursor, OpenCode, MCP servers and skills to support code writing, review and refactoring.

scai.description: Led the frontend team in developing a debt recovery management application based on a Micro-Frontend architecture. Worked with Angular, RxJS, PrimeNG and Bootstrap and implemented end-to-end tests with Cypress on key flows, reducing regression risk during releases. Technical mentoring, best practices, code review and alignment with business goals in an Agile context.

acca.description: Developed the Angular and RxJS frontend of usBIM.com, a Kanban application for workflow management, using Angular Material and DevExpress. Integrated REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, built real-time features with Socket.IO and managed persistence with MySQL in an Agile context.
